old_cards_resource.title: Remove old Nova Cards resource
old_cards_resource.description:
Nova Cards now ship with the Nova Homeverse integration. Dashboards → Resources still lists the separately installed file: {url}

The cards still only run once (the integration's version wins), but the old file is loaded for nothing. To get rid of it:

1. Open the **Marketplace**, find **Nova Cards** and choose **Remove** – this removes the resource as well.
2. Without the Marketplace: **Settings → Dashboards → ⋮ → Resources** and delete the entry.
3. Hard-reload the browser once (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R or clear the app cache).

Your dashboards stay as they are – the card types `custom:nova-…` do not change.

old_nova_installed.title: Remove the old “Nova” integration
old_nova_installed.description:
Nova is now called **Nova Homeverse**. The old “Nova” integration is still running, so Nova Homeverse does not start – the two cannot run side by side.

1. **Settings → Devices & services → Nova → ⋮ → Delete**.
2. Open “Nova” in the **Marketplace** and choose **Remove**.
3. Restart Home Assistant.

Your data (theme, notes, shopping, recipes, images) is kept and Nova Homeverse picks it up. Dashboards and cards do not change.
